'''2011 Minnesota State Championship Peter Jacobson DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Peter Jacobson]] at [[2011 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Michelle Bachman Occupation
* '''Username:''' Jeeps
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
